Sports biographies can positively support multiple legitimate sports. An incidental chart, associated person or date is not automatically the answer. Select support only for an original segment positively assigning this candidate to the requested relation; otherwise empty. Select counter only for actual counterevidence, not mere absence. conflict=same_referent only for incompatible claims for the same entity/attribute/relevant scope, not legitimate namesakes or complementary facts. entity labels are provisional groups, not truth. scope=excluded only for an explicit question constraint, with constraint selecting a literal numeric phrase from the question; otherwise allowed/unknown. observed_slot describes the answer's ACTUAL role, not the role wanted by the question. Mere disagreement does not make a source false. Fill all opaque keys.
Conservative audit with a granularity check. Verify each candidate against ALL original segments. A directly stated second artist, second namesake birth date or second sport is direct even if it is not the first candidate. Positive statement goes in support; counter is only actual incompatible evidence for that exact referent, never a support sentence relabeled negative. Equivalent date forms are not competing facts. Do not reject a date merely because wording or calendar notation differs. Likewise do not admit a loose synonym, associated person or more detailed date as a NEW independent answer. Respect the exact requested answer type; cities cannot answer when-born. Keep unresolved factual reliability separate from role errors.
